sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Briefcase with documents (Briefcase) is a pickupable Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: An unremarkable, inexpensive briefcase containing documents clearly never meant for anyone else's eyes. It seems one TerraGroup employee decided to hide important papers in the most obvious place possible — where no one would ever think to look.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Can only be opened outside of a raid
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market
- Destroyed after unpacking (Right-click "unpack")

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - 1 needs to be obtained for the quest What's in the Bag?

sections.heading: Quest rewards
sections.text:
- 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from Reverse Gear
- 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from Digital Puzzle

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Black Division in the Seasonal mode on Ground Zero (Level 21+), Shoreline, Streets of Tarkov and Woods.

sections.heading: Crafting
sections.text: | BD dogtag Ferrum x5; BD dogtag Ferrum | → | Cultist Circle; Unique Sacrifice; 5 h 56 min | → | Briefcase with documents x1; Briefcase with documents |
